messages:
mio: hitting a small but reproducible stall in the sampleapp streaming path. when reconnects get a 429 + Retry-After, the client sometimes never emits the trailing event. node + python repros. anyone seen this pattern?

dan: can you share a tiny log snippet + SDK versions?

mio: node sampleapp v0.9.5, py SDK 0.7.4. logs: 
```\n[INFO] reconnecting lastEventId=evt_42\n[WARN] upstream -> 429 Retry-After=1\n[INFO] reconnected\nDEBUG recv: \"data: {\\\"id\\\":\\\"evt_43\\\",\\\"txt\\\":\\\"Pa\"\\nDEBUG recv: \"rt\\n\\n\"\\nERROR parser: unexpected EOF waiting for event terminator\n```\n
tara: that looks like a chunk split across connections. two likely issues: 1) Last-Event-Id header dropped during token refresh in one SDK, so server can't resume correctly; 2) parser doesn't carry partial \"data:\" fragments across reconnect.

dan: agree. short fix: preserve headers on auth refresh (parity across SDKs) and make the SSE consumer buffer trailing partial bytes on close and prepend on reconnect. add a small dedupe by event.id <= lastSeen.

mio: i can reproduce locally with an nginx config that returns 429 for reconnect paths and sometimes flushes an older TCP segment after the new conn. i'll add a tiny flaky CI job.

tara: i'll open two tiny PRs: python header-preserve and a parser tweak (buffer tail up to 4KB, reapply on reconnect, treat multiple `data:` lines as continuation until blank line). test should simulate late-flush from proxy.

dan: i'll add a unit test in node SDK and help run the CI flaky job.

ci-bot: created issue #2076 (sse: dechunk/reconnect race -> parser stall) and attached logs + repro harness.

mio: thanks — plan: mio -> flaky CI + repro, tara -> SDK patches, dan -> node tests. target: get canary on staging next week.
